scope: Explicit test-only provider and language-policy fixture; validates persistence, source leases and assisted-only integration, not real Italian model quality.
checks: Unavailable production help stays hidden while authored workshop and lesson help remain available
The original workshop intention persists on reopen without generation, evidence or restored-output trust
Validated wording is explicitly inserted as an unsent draft, retains intention and produces only assisted workshop practice
A new suggested word uses real canonical drills but keeps their answers assisted and cannot mark the word learned
An edited source or navigation cancels late wording before receipts or input writes
Provider removal and learning epoch reset revoke open help and reject late output
Course hint exposure is ungraded and a subsequent canonical answer records assistance with one spoken sentence
A hint containing the canonical answer is rejected before display or assistance receipt
Explanation cards copy verified source material and the model does not become the lesson reference
Course portfolio wording preserves its original intention and remains an editable ungraded draft across reopen
Legacy Grammar help retains the exact original question and closes on learner replacement
Delayed initial workshop, Course audio and retained Grammar loads cannot replace a screen already left
